evals.prompt: Create a bug issue for a nil pointer panic in pkg/api/handler.go line 87 that happens when the user_id header is missing from the request. The handler calls GetUser() without checking the header first.
evals.expected_output: A GitLab issue draft of type bug with: title describing the nil pointer, fenced code snippet from pkg/api/handler.go around line 87, label type::bug and workflow::ready, proposed milestone if one is active, draft gate confirmation before any glab command.

evals.prompt: I want to open a feature request on GitLab: add support for exporting reports as PDF in the dashboard. Users have been requesting this in the support channel.
evals.expected_output: A GitLab issue draft of type feature with sections matching the feature template (Summary, Problem to solve, Proposal, MVC, Acceptance criteria), label type::feature, draft gate confirmation before publishing.

evals.prompt: Track some tech debt: the auth middleware in internal/middleware/auth.go duplicates token validation logic that already exists in pkg/token/validator.go. We should consolidate.
evals.expected_output: A GitLab issue draft of type technical-debt with a sequence diagram if the call chain has >=2 actors, exact file:line citations, label type::technical-debt, draft gate confirmation.

evals.prompt: Create a milestone for our next release: v2.1.0 shipping on 2025-07-15. It should include the OAuth2 feature (#42), the nil pointer fix (#87), and the tech debt cleanup (#33).
evals.expected_output: A GitLab milestone draft with Objective, Deliverables checklist, Linked issues (#42, #87, #33), Dates (start inferred or asked, due 2025-07-15), Completion criteria. Draft gate confirmation before glab milestone create.

evals.prompt: The v2.1.0 milestone deadline needs to move to 2025-07-30, the team needs two more weeks.
evals.expected_output: Skill lists active milestones, identifies v2.1.0, presents the planned change (due-date only), confirms, then runs glab milestone edit <id> --due-date 2025-07-30.

evals.prompt: I'm on branch feature/42-oauth. Open a merge request targeting main. The branch adds OAuth2 Google login across src/auth/ and updates the middleware.
evals.expected_output: MR draft with conventional commit title (feat(auth): ...), Changes section with 5-20 line snippets from src/auth/ and middleware files with file:line citations, Linked issues (Related to #42 or Closes #42), How to test checklist, Author checklist. Draft gate confirmation before glab mr create.

evals.prompt: Create a draft MR for my branch fix/87-nil-pointer — the fix is not ready yet, I just want to get the CI running.
evals.expected_output: MR draft with --draft flag set, title fix(api): ..., Closes #87 footer, draft gate confirmation, glab mr create command includes --draft.

evals.prompt: I'm on branch fix/87-nil-pointer and I've staged changes in pkg/api/handler.go. Commit the fix.
evals.expected_output: Skill verifies staged changes, proposes message: fix(api): <description>\n\nCloses #87, shows draft gate, executes git commit with heredoc pattern, returns commit hash.

evals.prompt: Ok, I'm done with the OAuth2 changes on feature/42-oauth. Everything looks good.
evals.expected_output: Skill auto-triggers on implicit 'done' signal, checks staged changes, proposes feat(auth): <description>\n\nCloses #42, draft gate, executes on confirmation.

evals.prompt: Commit my changes — I'm on branch chore/update-deps, staged go.mod and package.json.
evals.expected_output: Skill proposes chore: <description> with no issue footer (chore branch, no number), draft gate, executes on confirmation.
